params.body:
Tapping one of this week's signals in the opening cited it on the piece at once, so a piece with no words in it already showed a source. It now names the signal in the message with its id ("(insight ins-…)"); the writing chat treats it as at hand and cites it when a sentence of its suggestion uses it.

Pairs with the pipeline change that does the same for pieces started from Ask or from a research brief. Safe in either order.

Checks: `npm run build` and `npm test` (11 tests) on a fresh worktree from main.
params.title: Studio: a tapped starter names its source instead of citing it
